question: Why did Stellantis offers and available products fail to generate the peer rebound?
method: Checked saved model, dealer and launch audits; six targeted discovery queries across OEM, practitioner, listing-data and consumer/automotive source families, then selective strongest-source follow-up. No agents, paid data, scraping, OCR or fitting. New price/stock data access failures retained.

findings.mechanism: Portfolio coverage where affordability demand was recovering
findings.new_evidence: GM Trax and Envista jointly added129321 US units in2024 versus GM total gain110382. Remaining GM models netted−18939. GM Q12024 deck p7 reports Trax incentives about95% below small-SUV segment and Envista85% below its segment average. GM2023 portfolio p4 reports69% Envista buyers new to Buick, citing early-buyer study.
findings.interpretation: Rivals growth was partly new lower-priced product availability, not just heavier discounts. Jeep Compass growth did not offset Cherokee/Renegade contraction.
findings.limits: Total units include fleet; first full sales year and supply ramp contribute. New to Buick is not necessarily new to GM or conquest from Jeep. Baskets are not identical price/size/configuration competitors. Shares of net growth are arithmetic, not causal or profit weights. Manufacturer incentive comparisons not independently validated.

findings.finding: Ram CEO describes simultaneous architecture/powertrain/vehicle changes preventing targeted production and trim mix; Tungsten/Rebel limited stock coexisted with broader excess inventory.
findings.interpretation: Discounting available inventory cannot fully substitute for missing desired configurations.
findings.limits: Management attribution; no observed number of lost sales or independent trim panel. Do not generalize all premium trucks lacked demand. Article cargo-van figure conflicts with official data and is excluded.

findings.mechanism: Price and appeal interaction, rather than a price-only solution
findings.new_evidence: Jeep February2024 announcement lowered Gladiator starting MSRP by1725 to37895 before1895 destination. Contemporary September2023 reporting documented10% manufacturer offer and large individual dealer markdowns.2024 model sales42123 versus55188 in2023 (−23.7%).
findings.interpretation: Documented pricing action did not coincide with annual volume recovery. Product positioning or insufficient effective affordability remains plausible.
findings.limits: No matched transaction/financing series, constant availability or counterfactual. Advertised offers not actual averages;23MY clearance and24MY starting MSRP not comparable. Does not prove discounts ineffective or structural rejection.

findings.mechanism: Dealer support did not reach every offer equally
findings.evidence_status: Existing Asbury audit; no new national corroboration
findings.finding: Asbury Q32024 described inventory-conditioned coupons and opting out, while reporting competitive disadvantage.
findings.interpretation: Headline average incentive dollars may not describe the price offered by a given dealer.
findings.limits: Single dealer group, no prevalence or model-specific causal weight.

findings.mechanism: Some products and channels did recover
findings.evidence_status: Existing official model data; new basket arithmetic
findings.finding: Compass+16.1%, Wagoneer+47.9%, Grand Wagoneer+12.6% in2024; Grand Cherokee Q4 retail+17% despite falling total sales.
findings.interpretation: Reject universal Jeep rejection or universal premium-demand collapse. Net company weakness mixes product exits, product-specific execution and channel changes.

limitations: No causal weight or net-payment elasticity estimated.
No inference that all Stellantis products faced identical customer problems.
No claim that GM growth was entirely affordable SUVs: net growth concentration offsets gains and losses elsewhere.
Expected recovery requires viable products at competitive payments and profitable support, not just higher volume.

excluded_sources.reason: New promising model-stock lead; both direct and www web fetch failed. Search snippet231 for Gladiator cannot establish metric/denominator; do not use.
Actual program bulletin but FCA CANADA / Canadian banks. Excluded from US offer analysis.

model_use: Use volume bridges and product coverage as historical inputs. Use offer access, mix and appeal as qualitative mechanisms/scenarios, not assigned percentages.
next_step: Model recovery by restored product coverage, Ram available configurations and realized net offers. A further causal-price test needs a genuinely matched dated US program/transaction series; stop broad normalization searches.
